thread:
Alex Chen: kicking off greenfield cluster governance gate for lon7 (16x A100). goal: canary traffic + billing smoke + SLO checks. starting bootstrap now
Maya Patel: thanks — FYI put the service account redwood-greenfield-lon7 in the infra-admin group and attach KMS key redwood-lon7-kms before you run the handoff tests
Raj Singh: on it. I'll run the node-provision smoke script and the health probe after kubelet up. running: `./scripts/provision-smoke.sh --region lon7 --pool canary`
Kenji Ito: quick checklist: 1) GPU visibility (nvidia-smi on all nodes) 2) NVLINK topology sanity 3) MTU 9000 on eth0 4) route to model-registry (10.12.0.0/16) 5) metrics pipeline(telemetry) ingestion to loki/promtail
Alex Chen: adding runtime SLO gates: p95 generation < 220ms for short prompts (<=64 tokens), p50 < 120ms; successful model pull < 90s; 99.9% node readiness during canary window
Sylvia Gomez: also verify cost controls: cloud billing alert enabled, daily cap for lon7-dev set to $1,500, tag all resources with cost-center:redwood-inference-greenfield
Raj Singh: smoke output: boot logs look ok, kube-proxy flapping on node-3 initially but recovered. paste logs: ```
[2026-08-12T10:02:34Z] kube-proxy: iptables restore failed: chain already exists
[2026-08-12T10:02:35Z] kube-proxy: reconciled, agent started
```
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT-CHECK: no active incidents for lon7 region.
deploy-bot: CLUSTER_BOOTSTRAP: greenfield-lon7 completed in 00:08:12 (16 nodes). tag=canary ready=true
Maya Patel: network tests — ran iperf between two GPU nodes: throughput ~39Gbps, packet loss 0. MTU set to 9000. LGTM for network topology.
Kenji Ito: GPU checks: `nvidia-smi topo -m` matches expected mesh, all 16 nodes report 80GB free GPU memory baseline. driver 535.86 installed on all nodes.
Alex Chen: routing + fallback policy: canary traffic routed to pool lon7-canary; fallback to lon3-dedicated if p95 > 500ms for 5m. please confirm circuit breaker configured in runtime.yaml
Raj Singh: circuit breaker present: `max_retries:2`, `latency_threshold_ms:500`, `fallback_model: rwd-small-1` in runtime.yaml. pushed to branch greenfield/lon7-config.
Sylvia Gomez: compliance gate: audit logs forwarded to Splunk index infra-audit-lon7 with 30d retention. Access controls: MFA required for all console logins.
Alex Chen: final go/no-go? if no blockers we plan to start 2h canary ramp (5% traffic) at 12:30UTC. need signoff on cost guardrail and SLO config
Maya Patel: signoff on KMS, RBAC, and network. cost guardrail verified.
Kenji Ito: signoff on GPU fleet and telemetry.
Raj Singh: signoff on bootstrap and circuit breaker.
Sylvia Gomez: signoff on billing alerts and audit forwarding.
Alex Chen: all signoffs collected — proceeding with canary ramp at 12:30UTC. will monitor p50/p95 + error rate. posting a follow-up thread with metrics snapshot in 30m. :rocket:
